parameters.formDescription: Record something you noticed by hand. Scout classifies it and files it in your Notion signal map. Scout does not visit the link.

values.placeholder: Link to the post or profile, optional

parameters.content:
## Manual signal intake

An n8n form for signals you spot yourself. You paste a link and one or
two lines about what you saw. Claude qualifies it and Scout writes a
row into your Notion signal map.

Use this when something worth tracking shows up somewhere Scout does
not read on its own.

The workflow ships **inactive**. Activating it publishes the form URL,
so configure it first and only activate deliberately.

## Source labels are labels, not connectors

The **Source** dropdown records where *you* saw the signal. Scout does
not fetch, crawl, scrape, log into or monitor any of those platforms.
Nothing on this list is an integration.

A LinkedIn label routes the link to the **LinkedIn URL** property so it
stays clearly marked as something a human typed. Scout never retrieves
it.

If the classifier returns something unusable, the row is still created
with status **Needs review**. Submissions are never dropped silently.

## Configure before running

1. Open **Scout Setup** and paste your Notion database id.
2. Bind an Anthropic credential on **Classify (Claude)** and a Notion
   credential on **Create Notion Row**. Use HTTP Header Auth for both.

**Validate Input** runs before either API call. It rejects a submission
whose URL is not absolute http or https, whose name is outside 2 to 200
characters, or whose note is outside 10 to 5000 characters.

Claude classifies and drafts. It does not send. The **Draft** property
is a suggestion for you to edit or discard.
